own: I think instead we should have a reminder to them that before they pay, they need to realise that this is likely a final decision. The funds will be transferred to the trader, so make sure you are absolutely certain that this is your decision. And that way I don't think we need to ask them if they sent the money after they cancel, because why would they send the money then cancel, especially if we warn them ahead of time that this is likely a final outcome and it will be resulting in them receiving whatever Monero. Please turn to design for wording on this.
